label: main season
summary: E1 and E2 are indirect, second-hand reports (reliability classes 7 and 5) and remain unexplained after two NTS visits. Under the national criteria, weaker indirect evidence still unexplained after two visits becomes a target; technical survey is unavailable, so recommend clearance for sign-off.
flags: The reports are hearsay and do not establish an incident location within the area with certainty; this recommendation follows the national follow-up criteria, not a conclusion that EO presence is confirmed.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1, E2.

E1.quote: people should keep away from the area because of mines, but could not say who had seen anything, or where.
E1.note: A hearsay warning suggests possible EO but identifies no firsthand source or location; as an outside trader repeating unverified talk, it is class 7.

E2.quote: neighbours told her that an animal was killed by a mine somewhere in the area some years ago.
E2.note: This is a second-hand report of an incident with an imprecise location, suggesting possible EO but not confirming it; the shopkeeper repeats what neighbours told her.
